verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ أَشْرَفُ الْأَعْرَابِ وَالْعَجَمِ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ خَيْرُ مَنْ يَمْشِي عَلَى قَدَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun ashrafu l-aʿrābi wa-l-ʿajami. Muḥammadun khayru man yamshī ʿalā qadami.
verses.en: Muhammad, the noblest of the Arabs and the non-Arabs. Muhammad, the best of all who walk upon the earth.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ بَاسِطُ الْمَعْرُوفِ جَامِعُهُ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ صَاحِبُ الْإِحْسَانِ وَالْكَرَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun bāsiṭu l-maʿrūfi jāmiʿuhu. Muḥammadun ṣāḥibu l-iḥsāni wa-l-karami.
verses.en: Muhammad, the generous bestower of every good. Muhammad, the master of excellence and generosity.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ تَاجُ رُسْلِ اللَّهِ قَاطِبَةً ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ صَادِقُ الْأَقْوَالِ وَالْكَلِمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun tāju rusli Llāhi qāṭibatan. Muḥammadun ṣādiqu l-aqwāli wa-l-kalimi.
verses.en: Muhammad, the crown of all the Messengers of Allah. Muhammad, the truest in every word he spoke.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ ثَابِتُ الْمِيثَاقِ حَافِظُهُ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ طَيِّبُ الْأَخْلَاقِ وَالشِّيَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun thābitu l-mīthāqi hāfiẓuhu. Muḥammadun ṭayyibu l-akhlāqi wa-sh-shiyami.
verses.en: Muhammad, faithful to every covenant and every trust. Muhammad, whose noble character and virtues are unmatched.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ رُوِيَتْ بِالنُّورِ طِينَتُهُ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ لَمْ يَزَلْ نُورًا مِنَ الْقِدَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun ruwiyat bi-n-nūri ṭīnatuhu. Muḥammadun lam yazal nūran mina l-qidami.
verses.en: Muhammad, whose very nature was nourished with light. Muhammad, a light that has shone since pre-eternity.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ حَاكِمٌ بِالْعَدْلِ ذُو شَرَفٍ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ مَعْدِنُ الْإِنْعَامِ وَالْحِكَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun ḥākimun bi-l-ʿadli dhū sharafin. Muḥammadun maʿdinu l-inʿāmi wa-l-ḥikami.
verses.en: Muhammad, the noble judge who rules with perfect justice. Muhammad, the fountain of generosity and wisdom.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ خَيْرُ خَلْقِ اللَّهِ مِنْ مُضَرٍ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ خَيْرُ رُسْلِ اللَّهِ كُلِّهِمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun khayru khalqi Llāhi min Muḍarin. Muḥammadun khayru rusli Llāhi kullihimi.
verses.en: Muhammad, the finest of Allah's creation from the line of Mudar. Muhammad, the best of all the Messengers of Allah.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ دِينُهُ حَقٌّ نَدِينُ بِهِ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ مُجْمِلًا حَقًا عَلَى عَلَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun dīnuhu ḥaqqun nadīnu bihi. Muḥammadun mujmilan ḥaqqan ʿalā ʿalami.
verses.en: Muhammad, whose religion is the truth that we follow. Muhammad, exalted and manifest in truth.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ ذِكْرُهُ رَوْحٌ لِأَنْفُسِنَا ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ شُكْرُهُ فَرْضٌ عَلَى الْأُمَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun dhikruhu rawḥun li-anfusinā. Muḥammadun shukruhu farḍun ʿalā l-umami.
verses.en: Muhammad, whose remembrance brings comfort to our souls. Muhammad, whose praise is a duty upon every nation.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ زِينَةُ الدُّنْيَا وَبَهْجَتُهَا ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ كَاشِفُ الْغُمَّاتِ وَالْظُلَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun zīnatu d-dunyā wa-bahjatuha. Muḥammadun kāshifu l-ghummāti wa-ẓ-ẓulami.
verses.en: Muhammad, the beauty and delight of this world. Muhammad, the one who dispels darkness and distress.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ سَيِّدٌ طَابَتْ مَنَاقِبُهُ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ صَاغَهُ الرَّحْمٰنُ بِالنِّعَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun sayyidun ṭābat manāqibuhu. Muḥammadun ṣāghahu r-raḥmānu bi-n-niʿami.
verses.en: Muhammad, the master whose virtues are beyond compare. Muhammad, fashioned by the Most Merciful and adorned with every blessing.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ صَفْوَةُ الْبَارِي وَخِيرَتُهُ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ طَاهِرٌ مِنْ سَائِرِ التُّهَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun ṣafwatu l-bārī wa-khīratuhu. Muḥammadun ṭāhirun min sāi'ri t-tuhami.
verses.en: Muhammad, the Creator's chosen one and His elect. Muhammad, pure and free from every accusation.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ ضَاحِكٌ لِلضَّيْفِ مُكْرِمُهُ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ جَارُهُ وَاللَّهِ لَمْ يُضَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun ḍāḥikun li-ḍ-ḍayfi mukrimuhu. Muḥammadun jāruhu wa-Llāhi lam yuḍami.
verses.en: Muhammad, who welcomed every guest with a cheerful smile. Muhammad, by Allah, whose neighbour was never wronged.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ طَابَتِ الدُّنْيَا بِبِعْثَتِهِ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ جَاءَ بِالْآيَاتِ وَالْحِكَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun ṭābati-d-dunyā bi-biʿthatihi. Muḥammadun jā'a bi-l-āyāti wa-l-ḥikami.
verses.en: Muhammad, by whose mission the world was made blessed. Muhammad, who came with clear signs and wisdom.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ يَوْمَ بَعْثِ النَّاسِ شَافِعُنَا ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ نُورُهُ الْهَادِي مِنَ الظُّلَمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun yawma baʿthi n-nāsi shāfiʿunā. Muḥammadun nūruhu l-hādī mina ẓ-ẓulami.
verses.en: Muhammad, our intercessor on the Day mankind is resurrected. Muhammad, whose light guides us out of darkness.

verses.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ قَائِمٌ لِلَّهِ ذُو هِمَمٍ ۞ مُحَمَّدٌ خَاتَمٌ لِلرُّسْلِ كُلِّهِمِ
verses.tr: Muḥammadun qā'imun li-Llāhi dhū himamin. Muḥammadun khātamun li-r-rusli kullihimi.
verses.en: Muhammad, devoted to Allah and possessed of the loftiest resolve. Muhammad, the Seal of all the Messengers.
